raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.9.5" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-kmlshape
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/kmlShape_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/kmlShape/kmlShape_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 617542d4981bb3ae5b839358e446b00c0706185d4d4f8f0efe561284258c65dc

build:
  number: 6
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}              # [not win]
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}                # [not win]
    - {{ compiler('m2w64_c') }}        # [win]
    - {{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}          # [win]
    - {{ posix }}filesystem        # [win]
    - {{ posix }}make
    - {{ posix }}sed               # [win]
    - {{ posix }}coreutils         # [win]
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - xorg-libxfixes           # [linux]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-class
    - r-kml
    - r-lattice
    - r-longitudinaldata
    - libgl-devel                    # [linux]
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-class
    - r-kml
    - r-lattice
    - r-longitudinaldata

test:
  requires:
    - xorg-libxfixes  # [linux]
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('kmlShape')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('kmlShape')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: http:www.r-project.org
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  summary: K-means for longitudinal data using shape-respecting distance and shape-respecting means.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - '{{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2'

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
